## 4.2.2 (HexGhoul): regeneration only while you hold its key (X), slower, at a fifth of the price

HexKagune 4.2.2 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. **Protocol 129** (was 128): a server and everyone on it need this jar.

You said (quoted exactly): "Also, there's another thing I want patched is that regeneration is consuming way too much energy, and no longer
is it automatic. We're gonna bind a new key for all Kagunes that is called regeneration, except for the Bikaku. That guy already has a
regeneration ability. That from now on is that. To regenerate, you need to press that key, but it's optional. You don't automatically
regenerate anymore. You need to hold the key down, and it no longer consumes as much energy as it does. It's ridiculous how much it's
consuming."

"So like, as long as you're holding down that key, you start regenerating and your wounds are going to close. But if you don't, the wounds
are going to remain present on your body. And yeah, just slow down the regeneration in general. Even when holding the key down, make sure
it's slower than what it currently is. It's ridiculous right now. I cannot do anything and my energy is gone. I just need to be hit by a
creeper and my fucking energy is gone. It's ridiculous."

"Make sure the key is It's usable in any version of the like Kakugan activated, the option shows up in Kagune mode. The option shows up in
Kakuja forms. It shows up in full form like war path or peace path. It shows up. Every single form has this key there."

**The key:** "Regenerate (hold)", X by default, under HexKagune in Controls (rebind it there). Hold it and your wounds close; let go and
they stay open. Nothing heals you by itself any more. It works in every state and form: kagune in, ghoul eyes (kakugan), kagune out, every
kakuja (Rinkaku, Ukaku, Owl DNA, Graft), and War and Peace. Every one of those ability boards has a green "X hold Regenerate" as its last row.
It stops with any screen open, and if your game stops telling the server (lag, a crash) it stops on its own within a second and a half.

**Slower:** holding it heals half a health point (a quarter of a heart) a second at mastery 0, up to 1.25 points a second at mastery
1000. A full bar takes 40 seconds at mastery 0 and 16 at 1000. Before, it waited 15 seconds (5 at 1000) after your last hit and then closed
everything missing in 5 seconds (2 at 1000). Held, it's never faster than that was, for any wound. Regen Reservoir makes it 30% faster;
Graft DNA's kagune out and kakuja still heal faster, as before.

**Cheaper:** each point healed costs a fifth of what it did: 0.1 of the 20-point reserve instead of 0.5. Healing a full bar used to eat
half your reserve; now it's 2 points of 20. Graft DNA's RC cost for healing is a fifth too.

**Bikaku:** once Monstrous Regeneration is yours (mastery 600, and Noro has taught the Worms), it's your only regeneration: no key, no
healing by itself. Before that you hold X like everyone else (free, as a Bikaku's healing always was), or a new Bikaku could never heal at
all. "Abnormal Regeneration" (faster healing with the worm out) is gone with the old healing; the Bikaku menu and its board now say so
(Pain Suppression is still there).

**The rest:** War's and Peace's own small heal every second only counts with the key held (it was already cancelled on ghouls, like the
original mod's Regen Reservoir heal; neither ever heals by itself, and a test keeps it so). Potions of healing and regeneration still work.
Biting (Predatory Feeding), kills that feed you, Graft's Recovery and War's lifesteal are moves you make, not regeneration, and are unchanged.
